mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls signal labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with housing starts above 1900 thousand units and retail sales above 360000 million dollars, strong consumer demand drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1900 and RSAFS > 360000, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index over the prior 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1950 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals robust consumer confidence that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1950 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-driven expansion regimes where industrial production exceeds its 12-month moving average, manufacturing output growth supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month moving average, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
